notes.title: "LIGHT: Black Cat & Amnesia Girl" v0.99 Update new
notes.notes:
Hi,

Long time no see

LIGHT: Black Cat & Amnesia Girl will be updated to version 0.99. This update is not just about bug fixing, we also add new cutscenes, new features and screen optimizations. Let us briefly introduce them now.

1. Outfits system

Now you can help your girl change into different outfits and hair colors, we have prepared 11 different outfits. You can find the “shadow of cat” in the level to unlock new outfits.

2. New Cutscenes

We have added new cutscenes when each chapter is cleared, to give you a glimpse of the little girl's lost memories, and let you piece together the threads of memory to solve the puzzles hidden deep in your memory!

3. New screen optimization

We have made a comprehensive adjustment to the game’s lighting and shadows. Although there may not be much difference at first glance, we believe that it will still make the game experience more comfortable.

You can watch the  video of version v0.99 here
[previewyoutube=nP82JAVniqA;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, this update will be the last update for the Early Access version.

That’s mean, we will enter the official version in the next update, and the journey of the cat and the girl will also come to an end, and please accompany them to the end.

Although the offical release date is still uncertain yet, but we promise that it will be updated before the end of October.

Thank you your support.
Daylight Studio Team
